subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

And to think after all these years you still have the _____ to say such things to me!
solution:
The correct answer is "**arrogance**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Among the given options, the most appropriate word to fill the blank is in option 1.**

 
 
• **The word "arrogance" means having an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.**(अहंकार)

 
 
• ​Example: The arrogance of this man is surprising.
 
 
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because the speaker is expressing disbelief that someone would still speak to them in such a disrespectful manner after all these years.
 
• **The sentence structure is "you still have the _ to say such things to me," which indicates that the missing word should be a noun that describes the audacity or nerve of the person speaking.**
 
• Thus, the correct sentence will be:
 
 
• And to think after all these years you still have the arrogance__ to say such things to me!
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2 fitness means the condition of being strong and healthy. (पूर्ण स्‍वस्‍थता, पूरी तंदुरुस्‍ती)
 
• Option 3 (tangential) means diverging from the main topic or purpose and does not make sense in this context.(स्पज्या का)
 
• Option 4 (brightness) means the quality of shining with, or of producing, a lot of light. (चमक)
